text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: NEW INCIDENT CREATED — quota/ratelimit enforcement regression observed after infra-configs rollout. Pager: <https://pager.redwood.example/INC-2360001111>
maria_oncall: noticed surge of 429s at ~2360001109. Alerts firing for both hosted and several dedicated tenants. Quick check: latency and 5xx are fine. Root endpoint impacted: /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate.
liam_platform: checked config history: config apply (refs/heads/main) for ratecap-sync-service went through at 2360001098. Feature gate: quota_sync_v2 enabled globally. Rollout used global-config-store -> intended to be region-gated but gate mis-evaluated due to caching logic.
katie_sre: graphs show 429 share jumped to ~15% in eu-west and ap-southeast canaries. Dedicated tenant errors concentrated on tenants with long exemption lists. Looks like exemptions not being applied before enforcement.
deploy-bot: audit: user=ci-bot pipeline=infra-configs commit=c3a9f54 target=ratecap-sync-service action=apply envs=[prod]
sam_dl: logs: debit path invoked before exemptions were resolved. Found traces where ledger delta applied, then exemption lookup failed returning empty list, so enforcement saw balance <=0 -> 429. Example trace ids: trace-9f2a, trace-9f2b.
maria_oncall: trying feature-flag kill now. Executing console disable.
ops-bot: flag-update: quota_sync_v2 => disabled (by maria_oncall) at 2360001130
rachel_cs: CS reporting chatter from 9 paying customers shorting requests. Opening support ticket templates and pinging impacted accounts list.
alex_prod: can we apply emergency exemptions quickly for enterprise customers while we investigate? Need to stop customer-facing 429s asap.
peter_net: note: config-store publish was made without region shard checksum. The publish propagated to global cache before per-region gate reconciliation. That allowed dedicated cluster nodes to evaluate the new behavior prematurely.
liam_platform: mitigation plan:
- flip feature flag (done)
- push emergency exemptions for impacted tenants (in progress)
- rollback config publish if necessary
alex_prod: emergency exemption payload (applied):
```json
{"exempt_tenants": ["acme-inc","sysco-enterprise","prime-retail"], "scope": "dedicated"}
```
ops-bot: exemption update applied at 2360001145 by alex_prod
katie_sre: monitoring: hosted 429s down to 0.8% after kill-switch; dedicated improving but 2 tenants still show elevated 429s. Sending list to ops for manual override.
sam_dl: reproduction steps: simulate concurrent config writes where exemptions array gets merged as null when a second write hits the shard before the first write finishes. Patching to ensure merge is atomic and fallback uses last-known-exemptions.
maria_oncall: rolling back global publish to previous revision (b8f3c2) to be safe. Initiating rollback now.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated for publish c3a9f54 -> rolled back to b8f3c2 at 2360001165
jess_oncall: taking over on-call. Incident summary for channel:
- impact: quota_sync_v2 rollout caused early debit before exemptions load, triggering over-throttling (429) for hosted and some dedicated tenants.
- mitigation: feature flag disabled, emergency exemptions applied, config publish rolled back.
- customer impact: ~9 paying tenants affected; targeted outreach in progress by Rachel_CS. No SLA credits yet; assessing scope. Severity: S2 (partial customer impact)
liam_platform: next actions: PR to fix atomic merge and add safety that treats missing exemption lists as "safe-exempt" until a successful load. Add unit and integration tests. Also, add pre-publish checks in global-config-store to verify region gating won't be bypassed.
katie_sre: testing plan: extended canary that includes dedicated tenant tokens; verify exemption load completes before enforcement path allowed. Add a regression test for negative token balances.
ops-bot: note: a handful of config write entries around the time of the incident were performed by ci-bot and one manual operator (liam_platform) during a maintenance window. Please include full audit in incident ticket.
jess_oncall: assigning owners and scheduling postmortem: sam_dl owner for fix/PR, katie_sre owner for tests/canary, liam_platform owner for config-store gating, rachel_cs for customer comms. Postmortem scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT. Ticket INC-2360001111 created.
maria_oncall: handing off escalation to jess_oncall at 2360001185. Logs and traces uploaded to the incident ticket. Thanks everyone.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> status=resolved (partial verification pending). Please attach final artifacts and close after postmortem.
jess_oncall: will run through runbook, confirm rollback verification, and coordinate account-level follow ups. Leaving channel open for any late signals. :thumbsup:
